small_visual_text.where: Figure axes and legends, particularly in the bar charts, are difficult to read from a distance, which may hinder comprehension of the data.

dense_text.where: The Abstract and Discussion & Implications sections contain dense blocks of text, which may be challenging to scan quickly.

layout.reason: The layout is well-organized with clear section separation and efficient use of the canvas, but the dense text in some sections slightly affects the flow.

readability.reason: While the main text is legible, the figure axes and legends are too small to read easily, and dense text blocks reduce scanning efficiency.

fidelity.reason: The poster accurately emphasizes the main findings and includes relevant figures and tables that support the conclusions of the source paper.

holistic.reason: The poster is visually clear and effectively communicates the main findings of the paper, but small figure text and dense blocks of text slightly hinder readability.
